u199.rated_lines_info: (6) every black 2.4 pt line of the 4 code plans (2/A0.01 L1, 3/A0.01 L2, 1/A0.02 L3, 2/A0.02 L4, 3/32"=1'-0") chained by orientation; rating from the CODE LEGEND line style (continuous = 2 HR fire barrier / shaft; long-short = 1 HR fire partition; short dashes = 1 HR fire barrier; long+dot = 1 HR exterior; long+3 dots = 2 HR exterior; dotted = 3 HR bearing); mapped to A2.0x by x 4/3 + vector-registration offset (L1 (150,-596), L2 (-1460,-606), L3 (144,-644), L4 (-1448,-574) pt); each line split into runs by the counted wall that covers it (rating >= line, <= 11 pt); runs covered by walls drawn on enlarged sheets (A6.0x / A7.30 / A7.45 / A7.50) are written in that sheet's coordinates (A2 = 0.5 x sheet + offset, per-wall registration fit <= 3 pt). Runs: {'uncovered: no counted wall': 129, 'uncovered: lower-rated wall only': 106, 'covered': 232}; uncovered runs > 12 pt with a mechanical cause carry a disposition (control 6); 114 stay OPEN (u199.abiertos_E['6'], RV-E03). | 24_u199_F: the line style of every open run was re-read on the code-plan vectors against the CODE LEGEND strokes (A0.01): 50 runs are the dashes of '2 HR RATED EXTERIOR WALL' (27 pt dash + 3 dots, perimeter: CMU / open parking / glazing), 3 runs are '1 HR RATED FIRE BARRIER' (4.6 pt dashes, Linen 105, now covered by W.6-1); the rest are continuous 2 HR lines at CMU stair / hoistway / shaft enclosures or on loaded walls of lower printed rating (rating conflicts, RV-F01). rating_hr of the rows is left as E read it; the dispositions carry the correction.
